unit.why: A copied entry from the Apta communal register recording that young Israel son of Shabbetai (the Kozhnitzer Maggid) joined the Ner Tamid society in 1744. It is a documentary record, not a narrated tale, and it is followed by the heading of the next section (on the Seer of Lublin).
unit.boundary_note: division ends with the section heading 'מערכת ו׳ מחו׳ הרה״ק ר׳ יעקב יצחק מלובלין', which belongs with the next division
